observed_so_far.skew_definition: nextpnr's delay model: clock buffer -> fabric inverter LUT -> CK OBUFDS input, minus buffer -> LUT -> DQS OSERDES CLK of byte lane n (ps); not silicon

hypothesis: x32 calibrates and passes the pattern test when every lane's CK-DQS skew in nextpnr's model lies in roughly [-0.6, +0.8] ns, and fails when a lane is near or beyond -0.9 or +1.0 ns

seed10.predict: calibrates (lane 3 at +0.89 ns, like f07e91cd seed 1); pattern test uncertain

seed12.predict: calibrates, pattern test clean (lane 3 +0.78 ns, at the edge)

seed9.predict: fails (calibration retries or errors on U5), like seeds 2 and 5

note: five pass/fail observations and one delay model; a correlation, not a mechanism
